title: The one who left the Link
notes: The reveal: a rogue Changeling, the Founders' virus grafted to Borg
nanoprobes, and the plan for the Federation worlds. The logs have told it;
this is what it means now that she knows.

lines.text: INCOMING: U.S.S. ADIRONDACK
Shepard. Are you somewhere you can sit down?
INCOMING: U.S.S. ADIRONDACK
Shepard. Please pick up. This one's important.
We put the pieces together. Okafor, the Doctor, me.
The Founders' virus and Borg nanoprobes, in one engine.
A Changeling left the Great Link, years ago, on purpose.
It knew what Section 31 did to its people. The virus.
And it spent sixty years making that into this.

options.text: I know. It's on your last tape.

lines.text: Then you know I left the chair where it was. Good.
What the tape doesn't have is the part that's next.
Just one of them, on its own. I can't get past that.
One person, grieving for long enough, did all of it.
Because nobody was watching. There wasn't even a relay.
An order saying do not interfere. The Prime Directive
is what left this world undefended. I helped write it.
And because your world is the closest thing to Earth
anybody has ever found. It's a rehearsal.
For the Federation. The worlds that did this to it.
A horde is a Collective with no Queen, and nobody at
home knows it exists. We can't warn them. Comms dark.

options.text: Then we have to get word out.
What do you want me to do?

lines.text: No. It's the one that watched you die and took notes.
You don't owe it anything. I'm not going to ask.
Stay alive. Keep bringing my people up, and keep the tapes.
If a ship ever does come, I want the whole record.
All of it, in the order it happened.
Shepard out.
